  "checks": [
    {"candidate_id":"n_pm","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"PM is explicitly named as the actor organizing the review.","sources":[{"quote":"PM must organize","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_organize","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Organization is an affirmative main obligation under must.","sources":[{"quote":"PM must organize a review","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_review","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The review is the embedded event being organized; no separate reviewer is named.","sources":[{"quote":"organize a review of users.csv","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_users_file","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The file is review material and is explicitly protected against editing.","sources":[{"quote":"a review of users.csv","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null},{"quote":"users.csv must not be edited.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_verify","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Verification is expressed as a purpose associated with the review, without an independently stated obligation or named verifier.","sources":[{"quote":"a review of users.csv to verify","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_user","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Active users are the subjects of the embedded ownership criterion.","sources":[{"quote":"every active user has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_active","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Active modifies user and restricts the quantified population.","sources":[{"quote":"every active user","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_owner","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Owner is a relational role within the ownership criterion, not an assigned execution actor.","sources":[{"quote":"every active user has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_has_owner","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Having an owner is verification content, not an independently asserted fact or remediation instruction.","sources":[{"quote":"verify that every active user has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_deliver","verdict":"NO_EVIDENCE","reason":"Delivery is explicit, but its MAIN layer and REQUIRED modality are not unambiguous: deliver can coordinate with organize under must or with verify under to.","sources":[{"quote":"PM must organize a review of users.csv to verify that every active user has an owner and deliver user-audit.md.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_audit","verdict":"NO_EVIDENCE","reason":"The named file is delivered, but generation of that file is not stated; GENERATED_OUTPUT invents provenance.","sources":[{"quote":"deliver user-audit.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"n_edit","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Must not explicitly prohibits editing; the negative wording and forbidden modality describe the same prohibition.","sources":[{"quote":"users.csv must not be edited.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_pm_organize","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"PM is the grammatical subject of organize and therefore an actual performer of organization.","sources":[{"quote":"PM must organize","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_review_organize","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The review is structurally embedded as the event organized; this does not assign PM as its reviewer.","sources":[{"quote":"organize a review","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_review_file","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Users.csv is explicitly the material reviewed.","sources":[{"quote":"a review of users.csv","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_verify_review","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The purpose phrase is structurally associated with the review. PART_OF is supported as embedding, not as an independently required execution step.","sources":[{"quote":"a review of users.csv to verify","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_content_verify","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The ownership proposition is the embedded content of verification.","sources":[{"quote":"verify that every active user has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_active_user","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The active state describes the user.","sources":[{"quote":"active user","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_has_owner_user","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The user is the entity whose ownership state is evaluated; this binding does not imply modifying the user.","sources":[{"quote":"every active user has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_has_owner_owner","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Owner is the relational complement of has.","sources":[{"quote":"has an owner","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_pm_deliver","verdict":"NO_EVIDENCE","reason":"PM performs delivery under the main-clause coordination reading. Under purpose coordination, the delivery actor is not explicitly established as PM; SHARED_EXPLICIT collapses this ambiguity.","sources":[{"quote":"PM must organize a review of users.csv to verify that every active user has an owner and deliver user-audit.md.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_conjoined_actions","verdict":"NO_EVIDENCE","reason":"And marks coordination, but organize is not the uniquely determined other conjunct; verify is also a grammatical attachment.","sources":[{"quote":"organize a review of users.csv to verify that every active user has an owner and deliver user-audit.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_deliver_output","verdict":"NO_EVIDENCE","reason":"Delivery names the transferred artifact as its theme. The source does not establish the file as a produced result.","sources":[{"quote":"deliver user-audit.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_edit_file","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Users.csv is explicitly the patient of the prohibited editing operation.","sources":[{"quote":"users.csv must not be edited.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r_forbidden_edit","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"The explicit prohibition applies to editing users.csv within the task.","sources":[{"quote":"users.csv must not be edited.","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"x_every_active_user","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"Every universally quantifies active users within the verification proposition, not execution iterations or an artifact count.","sources":[{"quote":"every active user","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]}
  ],
